parsed.draft_response:
Hi team, thanks for the detailed report—and we understand the time pressure for Friday close. We’ve flagged this for engineering review as a high-urgency issue.

To help us pinpoint the cause quickly, could you share the following:
1) The exact 500 error details (response body/message) from the browser network log or the system logs, plus the timestamp when it first started (and timezone).
2) Steps to reproduce: whether it happens for all invoices or only specific ones (e.g., a date range or invoice IDs), and what filter/format you use before clicking Export.
3) Confirm the environment affected (production vs any specific region), and whether there were any deployments/config changes around “this morning”.

If you’re able, also let us know what differs between the invoice export and the customer export (route/parameters or any filters), since you mentioned customer exports aren’t impacted.

In the meantime, we’ll continue supporting your manual workaround while engineering investigates the invoice-page CSV export 500 error.
